feishu-case-007.name: 蜡笔涂鸦风
feishu-case-007.style: 蜡笔涂鸦风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-007.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-007.originalPrompt:
[任务与构图]
将上传照片重绘为一张 8:5 横版蜡笔旅行插画。只输出完整插画，不保留摄影分区。保留主体轮廓、主要透视方向和场景关系，选择有记忆点的建筑、人物或物件，删减杂乱细节。

[线条与上色]
以粗颗粒粉笔与蜡笔式轮廓为主，线条略粗、松弛、轻微抖动，笔端钝圆；保留粉末颗粒、干涩断色和不完全闭合的边缘。用稀疏的同向短笔触、轻薄粉彩色块和少量网格、条纹提示建筑结构，让纸白从笔触间透出。人物和环境细节概括为少量同样粗涩的线条，不做精细彩铅写实描摹或完整明暗塑形。

[纸面与颜色]
整幅为极浅、明亮、干净的近白纸底，纸纤维仅轻微可见；纸底明显亮于线条和色块，不偏棕、不泛黄、不发灰、不做陈旧纸。从原图提取两至四种主要颜色，调成明亮柔和的浅珊瑚橙、蓝绿、奶油黄等粉彩蜡笔色；深海军蓝统一用于主体轮廓、建筑结构线、副标题及注释。色块轻薄、保持露纸，不使用暗砖红、泥土色或厚重填色。避免脏灰阴影、荧光色和厚重油画体积。

[文字与留白]
主要街景横向展开，集中在画面中下部和右侧；左上和建筑上方留出连贯纸白，底部保留注释区，不把零散细节填满空白。
左上主标题写“LONDON STREET NOTES”，用珊瑚红粗颗粒手写字；下方副标题写“STEPHEN’S STREET”，用深蓝手写字。左下写“EVERYDAY CITY MOMENTS”。文字保持松弛手绘感，清晰可读；不新增电话号码、网址或商业宣传文案。

[完成要求]
线条、色块与文字都保持手绘感。不要做摄影与绘画对照、贴纸网格、3D 渲染或添加水印。

recipe.effect: 参考蜡笔涂鸦风样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and composition]
Redraw the uploaded photograph as an 8:5 landscape crayon travel illustration. Return one fully illustrated scene with no photographic section. Preserve recognizable silhouettes, main perspective directions and scene relationships. Select memorable buildings, people or objects and simplify incidental clutter.

[Linework and color]
Use coarse chalk-and-crayon contours as the dominant mark: slightly thick, relaxed and uneven, with rounded stroke ends, powdery grain, dry pigment breaks and occasional open edges. Suggest architecture with sparse directional short strokes, light pastel patches and a few grids or stripes, letting white paper show between marks. Reduce people and incidental details to a few equally rough lines. Avoid precise realistic colored-pencil drawing and fully modeled shading.

[Paper and palette]
Use a very light, bright, clean near-white paper ground with barely visible fibers. Keep it distinctly brighter than the lines and color patches, without brown, yellowed, gray or aged-paper effects. Extract two to four dominant colors from the source and translate them into bright, gentle pastel-crayon tones such as pale coral-orange, blue-green and cream-yellow. Use deep navy consistently for subject outlines, architectural lines, the subtitle and note. Keep color patches light with exposed paper; avoid dark brick red, earthy colors and heavy fills. Avoid muddy gray shadows, neon colors and heavy oil-painted volume.

[Lettering and whitespace]
Spread the street scene across the middle, lower area and right. Keep connected areas of white paper at upper left and above the buildings, plus a lower note area; do not fill these spaces with incidental details.
At upper left, write “LONDON STREET NOTES” in coarse coral-red handwriting. Below it write “STEPHEN’S STREET” in navy handwriting. At lower left write “EVERYDAY CITY MOMENTS”. Keep all lettering relaxed, handmade and readable. Add no phone numbers, websites or advertising copy.

[Finish]
Keep outlines, color and lettering handmade. No photo-versus-drawing comparison, sticker grid, 3D rendering or watermark.

feishu-case-002.name: 分层纸雕风
feishu-case-002.style: 分层纸雕风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-002.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-002.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片改编为一张约 4:3 横版的层叠纸雕海报。整张画面都是纸艺作品，不嵌入原始照片，不做上下对照。

[主体与空间]
提取原图最有辨识度的主体、轮廓和空间关系，构成一个完整的纸雕场景。保留关键结构与主体之间的大小关系；简化琐碎细节，用前景、中景、背景的纸层、遮挡和负形组织空间。以一个核心主体作为视觉锚点，主视觉集中在中下部；顶部和左上标题周围保留连贯的象牙纸负空间，不用零碎纸雕填满背景。

[纸张与光影]
使用细纤维哑光卡纸、干净的切边、轻微折痕与可辨识的纸层厚度。通过切割、压折、卷曲和叠放形成体积，自然漫射光从侧面照入，在层间产生柔和真实的接触阴影。纸张细腻、有手工触感，避免廉价卡纸感、塑料高光和黏土质感。

[配色与文字]
以暖象牙纸底承托原图提取的少量和谐主色，深色纸层建立结构，浅色叠层与少量鲜明色作点缀。避免霓虹色和复杂渐变。
左上主标题分两行写“LIBERTY”和“RISING”，使用大号高对比衬线字，带浅纸雕浮起效果。
标题下安排三组细小辅助文字：第一组写“STATUE OF LIBERTY”；第二组分两行写“SECTION I — SILHOUETTE”和“LAYER 01 / 03”；第三组分两行写“PAPER FORM”和“CUT / FOLD / LAYER”。右下第四组分三行写“CHAPTER MARK”“EDITION NO. 7”“MINIMAL MONUMENT”。引号内的斜杠是需要印出的字符。小字采用纤细、克制的编辑排版，与纸层边缘、几何轴和负空间对齐。不添加年份、地点、坐标或其他文案。

[输出约束]
只输出一张完整海报。主体清晰、纸层有序、文字不遮挡关键轮廓；不添加原照对照区、水印或无关装饰。

recipe.effect: 参考分层纸雕风样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Turn the uploaded photograph into one approximately 4:3 landscape layered-paper poster. Render the entire image as paper art; do not embed the original photograph or make a before-and-after split.

[Subject and space]
Extract the photograph's most recognizable subjects, silhouettes and spatial relationships into a unified paper scene. Preserve key structures and relative subject sizes. Simplify incidental details; organize depth with foreground, middle and background paper layers, occlusion and negative shapes. Use one core subject as the visual anchor, concentrating the scene in the middle and lower area. Preserve connected ivory-paper negative space at the top and around the upper-left title; do not fill it with incidental paper details.

[Paper and light]
Use matte cardstock with subtle fibers, clean cut edges, slight creases and visible layer thickness. Build volume through cutting, folding, curling and stacking. Natural diffused light enters from the side, producing soft, credible contact shadows between layers. Keep the paper refined and tactile; avoid cheap cardstock, plastic highlights and clay surfaces.

[Color and typography]
Use warm ivory paper beneath a limited, harmonious palette drawn from the photograph. Dark layers define structure; light layers and sparse vivid accents add depth. Avoid neon colors and complex gradients.
At upper left, set “LIBERTY” and “RISING” on two lines in large high-contrast serif lettering with shallow raised-paper relief.
Place three small text groups below: first, “STATUE OF LIBERTY”; second, “SECTION I — SILHOUETTE” and “LAYER 01 / 03” on two lines; third, “PAPER FORM” and “CUT / FOLD / LAYER” on two lines. At lower right, set a fourth group on three lines: “CHAPTER MARK”, “EDITION NO. 7”, “MINIMAL MONUMENT”. Print all slashes inside the quoted wording literally. Use fine, restrained editorial microtype aligned to paper edges, geometric axes and negative space. Add no years, locations, coordinates or other wording.

[Output constraints]
Return one finished poster with recognizable subjects, orderly paper layers and unobstructed key silhouettes. No photo comparison panel, watermark or unrelated decoration.

feishu-case-011.name: Riso 复古印刷风
feishu-case-011.style: Riso 复古印刷风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-011.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-011.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
把上传的人物照片转换为一张 3:2 横版 Riso 复古旅行日记海报，整幅统一为套色印刷插画，不拼接原照。

[主体与场景]
保留人物的脸部识别特征、发型、神态、服装、姿态及与环境的关系。人物位于画面中部，环境围绕人物展开；适度概括细节，以轮廓、阴影形状和线条保持可辨识性，不换脸、不添加其他人物。

[印刷语言]
以深海军蓝、暖橘或珊瑚色、奶油色为主，允许极少量原场景辅助色；整体低饱和、色调统一，保留清晰的深浅对比。用有限色版、细密网点、干墨颗粒、油墨斑驳、轻微套色偏移和手绘轮廓重建影调；纸张颗粒明显，带温暖的旧印刷触感。不要做成照片上覆盖一层滤镜，也不要使用光滑渐变或塑料立体效果。

[文案与排版]
左下主标题写“By the Street”，使用大号深蓝手写体；其下小字分两行写“A SMALL DIARY”和“#001”。
左上中文分两行写“风从街角来”“一杯咖啡的时间”；下方英文分三行写“Soft light on old stone”“A quiet pause in the day”“Somewhere between here and away”。
右上分两行写“OCT 2024”“STREET NOTES”；右侧竖排小字写“Gathering moments along the way”。所有文案逐字准确，文字避开人物面部和手部，不堆满留白。

[整体气氛]
温柔、文艺、温暖、怀旧，保留轻微电影感的明暗层次，同时统一为复古印刷插画，呈现独立杂志与旅行日记的编辑感。仅输出一张横版成品，不增加上下分区、边框或水印。

recipe.effect: 参考Riso 复古印刷风样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Convert the uploaded portrait photograph into one 3:2 landscape risograph travel-diary poster. Use a consistent printed illustration across the whole image, without an original-photo panel.

[Subject and setting]
Preserve the person's recognizable facial features, hairstyle, expression, clothing, pose and relationship to the surroundings. Place the person in the central area with the setting extending around them. Simplify detail through contours, shadow shapes and linework while retaining identity. Do not replace the face or add people.

[Print language]
Use deep navy, warm orange or coral, and cream, with very sparse supporting colors from the scene. Keep saturation restrained and the palette unified while retaining clear value contrast. Rebuild tones with limited ink separations, fine halftone, dry grain, mottled ink, slight misregistration and drawn outlines. Show noticeable paper grain and a warm vintage-print surface. Avoid simply overlaying a filter on a photo, smooth gradients or plastic volume.

[Copy and layout]
Set “By the Street” in large navy handwriting at lower left, with “A SMALL DIARY” and “#001” on two small lines beneath it.
At upper left, set the Chinese lines “风从街角来” and “一杯咖啡的时间”. Below them set three small English lines: “Soft light on old stone”, “A quiet pause in the day”, and “Somewhere between here and away”.
At upper right, set “OCT 2024” and “STREET NOTES” on two lines. Set “Gathering moments along the way” vertically at the right edge. Reproduce all wording exactly, clear of the face and hands, and preserve breathing room.

[Mood]
Gentle, artistic, warm and nostalgic, with subtly cinematic value relationships unified into vintage printed illustration and independent-magazine travel-diary design. Return one landscape poster without an upper/lower split, border or watermark.

preservedText: A quiet pause in the day

feishu-case-049.name: 单色编辑印刷
feishu-case-049.style: 单色编辑印刷。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-049.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-049.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片改编为一张 3:4 竖版单色编辑印刷海报。保留可辨识的主要物件和材质特征，允许局部裁切、放大与重新组合，形成一个明确的视觉中心。

[单色印刷]
仅使用深钴蓝油墨与中性白纸。通过网点密度、细线和露纸表现深浅及摄影细节，不给整张照片简单罩蓝色滤镜，不添加第二种彩墨。保留干净的印刷颗粒和轻微不完美，避免厚重旧纸污渍。

[构图与文字]
将主体和文字交错安排，大号高对比衬线字覆盖部分背景并穿插物件轮廓。主标题分两行写“Coffee”“Reading”；左上小号说明分两行写“morning light”“two books”；右下画一个细线手绘圆圈，圈内写“read here”，分为上行“read”、下行“here”，使用松弛自然的手写笔迹。左上辅助说明使用清楚的无衬线字。全部文字只用同一种深钴蓝油墨。

[空间与约束]
约三分之一画面保留可见白纸，并形成至少一处连续安静的留白；利用主体周围和文字之间的白纸建立呼吸感，主体与字形均清楚可辨。不要把所有文字统一成粗窄无衬线，不做多色 Riso、渐变背景、装饰贴纸堆叠或水印。只输出一张成品。

promptLocales.zh-CN:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片改编为一张 3:4 竖版单色编辑印刷海报。保留可辨识的主要物件和材质特征，允许局部裁切、放大与重新组合，形成一个明确的视觉中心。

[单色印刷]
仅使用深钴蓝油墨与中性白纸。通过网点密度、细线和露纸表现深浅及摄影细节，不给整张照片简单罩蓝色滤镜，不添加第二种彩墨。保留干净的印刷颗粒和轻微不完美，避免厚重旧纸污渍。

[构图与文字]
将主体和文字交错安排，大号高对比衬线字覆盖部分背景并穿插物件轮廓。主标题分两行写“Coffee”“Reading”；左上小号说明分两行写“morning light”“two books”；右下画一个细线手绘圆圈，圈内写“read here”，分为上行“read”、下行“here”，使用松弛自然的手写笔迹。左上辅助说明使用清楚的无衬线字。全部文字只用同一种深钴蓝油墨。

[空间与约束]
约三分之一画面保留可见白纸，并形成至少一处连续安静的留白；利用主体周围和文字之间的白纸建立呼吸感，主体与字形均清楚可辨。不要把所有文字统一成粗窄无衬线，不做多色 Riso、渐变背景、装饰贴纸堆叠或水印。只输出一张成品。
promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Adapt the uploaded photograph into a 3:4 portrait monochrome editorial print poster. Preserve recognizable principal objects and material cues while allowing local cropping, enlargement and recomposition around one clear focal event.

[Single-ink treatment]
Use only deep cobalt-blue ink and neutral white paper. Describe tonal values and photographic details through halftone density, fine lines and exposed paper, rather than placing a blue filter over the entire photo. Do not add a second colored ink. Retain clean print grain and slight imperfection without heavy aged-paper stains.

[Composition and text]
Interweave subjects and lettering. Large high-contrast serif type overlaps parts of the background and object contours. Set “Coffee” and “Reading” as a two-line headline. At upper left, set “morning light” and “two books” on two small lines. At lower right, draw one fine hand-drawn circle containing “read here”, with “read” above “here” in relaxed natural handwriting. Use clear sans-serif for the upper-left supporting copy. Print all wording in the same cobalt-blue ink.

[Space and constraints]
Leave about one-third of the image as exposed white paper, including at least one connected quiet area. Use paper around subjects and between letters for breathing room. Keep both subjects and letterforms legible. Do not turn all type into bold condensed sans serif. Avoid multicolor risograph, gradient backgrounds, piles of decorative stickers and watermarks. Return one finished poster.

feishu-case-003.name: 实景延伸线稿 · 旅行
feishu-case-003.style: 实景延伸线稿 · 旅行。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-003.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-003.originalPrompt:
1. 基础配置 (Canvas Specs)

画幅比例：2:3 竖版海报。

构图划分：上下严格 1:1 分割。中线以上为真实照片，中线以下为纸质插画。

2. 上半部分：真实照片 (Upper Photo)

照片处理：使用上传照片，保持原有的色彩、光影、细节与构图，不重绘、不拉伸。

主体内容：[示例：山水绿树间一位撑篙划船的舟子]

3. 下半部分：纸质画布 (Lower Line Art Canvas)

背景质感：中性暖白象牙纸，带有微弱细纤维纹理，保留大面积留白。

线稿小人：

比例：占画面总高度约 7%—10%。

风格：黑色极简钢笔线稿，线条纤细自然，无清晰五官。

动作：[示例：戴帽子背背包的小人，正双手展开拉着一条卷轴]

4. 核心过渡与互动 (Visual Bridge & Interaction)

延伸元素：从照片中的 [示例：碧绿湖水/河流] 自然下延。

无缝衔接：该元素跨过正中分割线，从真实摄影质感无缝渐变为黑色钢笔线稿/插画纹理，无断层。

视觉互动：[示例：延伸出来的河流化为画轴上的山水风景，被线稿小人缓缓展开拉动]。

5. 排版与氛围 (Typography & Vibe)

英文短句：手写体文字，字号较小，置于空白处。

内容：[示例：Let the quiet carry you.]

整体风格：高级、克制、诗意、具有编辑感与巧妙视觉隐喻。

6. 负向提示 (Negative Prompt)

避免：上下完全断开、悬浮人物、巨大人物、Q版画风、复杂五官、厚重边框、拼贴网格、水印、过大文字。

promptLocales.en:
1. Canvas Specs

Aspect ratio: 2:3 vertical poster.

Composition: Strict 1:1 split between top and bottom. Above the center line is a real photo; below it is a paper-based illustration.

2. Upper Photo

Photo treatment: Use the uploaded photo, preserving its original colors, lighting, details, and composition. Do not redraw or stretch it.

Subject: [Example: a boatman using a pole amid mountains, water, and green trees]

3. Lower Line Art Canvas

Background texture: Neutral warm-white ivory paper with subtle fine fibers and large areas of negative space.

Small line-drawn figure:

Scale: Approximately 7%–10% of the total image height.

Style: Minimalist black pen line art, with fine, natural lines and no defined facial features.

Action: [Example: a small figure wearing a hat and backpack, spreading both hands to pull open a scroll]

4. Visual Bridge & Interaction

Extending element: Naturally extend [example: the emerald lake/river] from the photograph downward.

Seamless connection: The element crosses the central dividing line, transitioning seamlessly from photographic realism into black pen line art/illustration texture, with no discontinuity.

Visual interaction: [Example: the extended river becomes the landscape on the scroll, which the line-drawn figure slowly unrolls].

5. Typography & Mood

Short English phrase: Small handwritten text placed in the negative space.

Content: [Example: Let the quiet carry you.]

Overall style: Sophisticated, restrained, poetic, editorial, with a clever visual metaphor.

6. Negative Prompt

Avoid: Completely disconnected halves, floating figures, giant figures, chibi style, complex facial features, heavy borders, collage grids, watermarks, oversized text.

feishu-case-020.name: Riso 复古装饰插画
feishu-case-020.style: Riso 复古装饰插画。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-020.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-020.originalPrompt:
[画面规格与版式]
- 比例尺幅：3:4 竖版复古装饰海报，全画幅插画满铺。
- 画中画元素：画面 [指定位置，如：右下角] 保留一张约 20% 画面宽度的原始照片小方框，保持摄影真实质感不变。

[主体提取与构图]
- 主体处理：提取照片中最具辨识度的主体（如：[在此输入核心主体，例如：街道建筑与转角反光镜]），选择性精简杂物与细碎背景。
- 空间重构：重新安排主体的大小、层叠关系与边缘裁切，形成主次分明、疏密有致的平面构图。

[色彩方案（哑光平涂）]
- 主色调（约 65%）：雾霾蓝。
- 辅助色：奶油黄、鼠尾草绿、米白。
- 渲染风格：全部采用哑光平涂（Matte flat color），无渐变、无立体光影。

[纹理与线条细节]
- 图形概括：物体概括为自然、不规则的平面形状。
- 手绘线条：采用细而略有起伏的手绘线条勾勒。
- 内部纹理：结合顺着形体排列的叶脉、条纹、格纹或斑点，实现密集纹样与完整色块的交替呼应。
- 背景铺底：大面积蓝色背景上铺设细小波点或成组的竖向虚线。

[文字与排版]
- 文本内容：搭配简短英文标题与副标题（例如主标题：“[在此输入大写主标题文字]”，副标题：“[在此输入错落分行短句]”）。
- 字体风格：奶油黄复古衬线大写字，疏排标题与错落分行短句，自然融入画面的空白间隙中。

[整体质感与负面约束]
- 总体风格：柔和的复古套色印花质感，保留轻微的手工感（Hand-crafted feel）。
- 避雷（Negative）：严禁渐变、立体光影、粗描边、厚重颗粒感和无关花草。

promptLocales.en:
[Format & Layout]
- Format: 3:4 vertical retro decorative poster with a full-bleed illustration.
- Picture-in-picture: Retain a small rectangular original photo approximately 20% of the image width at [specified position, e.g., bottom right], keeping its photographic realism unchanged.

[Subject Extraction & Composition]
- Subject treatment: Extract the photo's most recognizable subject (such as [enter the core subject, e.g., street buildings and a corner traffic mirror]), selectively simplifying clutter and small background details.
- Spatial reconstruction: Rearrange subject sizes, layering, and edge cropping to create a flat composition with clear hierarchy and varied density.

[Color Scheme: Matte Flat Color]
- Main color (approximately 65%): Hazy blue.
- Supporting colors: Cream yellow, sage green, off-white.
- Rendering: All colors are matte and flat, without gradients or three-dimensional lighting.

[Texture & Line Details]
- Shape simplification: Reduce objects to natural, irregular flat shapes.
- Hand-drawn lines: Fine, slightly undulating hand-drawn outlines.
- Internal texture: Combine veins, stripes, grids, or spots following the forms, alternating dense patterns with solid color blocks.
- Background: Small dots or grouped vertical dashed lines across large blue areas.

[Text & Typography]
- Copy: Pair a short English title and subtitle (e.g., main title: "[Enter uppercase title text here]"; subtitle: "[Enter a short phrase with staggered line breaks here]").
- Type style: Cream-yellow retro serif capitals, loosely spaced titles and staggered short phrases, naturally fitted into empty spaces in the image.

[Overall Texture & Negative Constraints]
- Overall style: Soft retro multicolor print texture with a slight hand-crafted feel.
- Avoid: Gradients, three-dimensional lighting, thick outlines, heavy grain, and unrelated flowers or plants.

feishu-case-004.name: 胶带拼贴图案
feishu-case-004.style: 胶带拼贴图案。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-004.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-004.originalPrompt:
将上传的照片转化为一幅精致、克制、具有真实手作质感的和纸胶带拼贴作品。

【主体提炼】
识别照片最重要的主体，保留 1–3 个关键辨识特征，例如轮廓、姿态、结构或代表性色彩。用约 10–18 块宽窄适中的和纸胶带重新构成主体。复杂场景只保留一个核心视觉焦点；必要时加入 1–2 个来自原图的环境元素，例如地面色块、窗格或植物轮廓。简化细节，但保持主体可辨认。

【胶带材质】
主体本身由胶带拼成。胶带以纯色为主，少量使用条纹、格纹或波点。呈现细腻的哑光纸纤维、轻微透光、柔软毛边、自然裁切与少量撕边；叠压处颜色略深，带细窄的接触阴影。允许少量不规则接缝、轻微褶皱和翘起的边角，整体保持平整、浅层叠贴的质感。

用相邻的明、中、暗胶带色块表达体积与结构。把手、茎叶、边缘等细节用窄胶带、留白或叠贴接缝表现，不使用铅笔线、墨线或绘制轮廓。

【配色】
从原照片提取 4–6 种协调的低饱和颜色，最多加入一种克制的暖色点缀。保留轻微手工染色的不均匀感，避免光滑渐变、高饱和撞色和塑料光泽。

【画幅与构图】
默认输出一张 3:4 竖版作品。主体位于画面中央偏下，略带不对称平衡；主体组合约占画面宽度的 40%–55%、高度的 32%–48%，保留约 65%–80% 的安静留白。主体、阴影和文字距离纸边至少留出画面短边约 9% 的空间。

【纸张与光线】
背景是一张连续、干净的暖白色手帐纸。纸面具有细微但在正常观看尺寸下仍可辨认的纤维、轻微纸浆起伏和少量不规则细点，纹理低对比、自然、不重复。柔和漫射光，阴影短而轻。避免泛黄、污渍、大块斑驳和过度做旧。

【原照片呈现】
默认只输出胶带重构作品，不把原照片放进成品。

【文字】
提供文字时准确使用；要求无文字时不添加。其他情况下，照片创作搭配一个描述可见主体的 1–3 词英文短标题，使用清晰、略带褪色感的打字机字体，放在主体附近但不重叠。不要编造地点、日期或身份。纯文字主题创作默认不加标题。

【避免】
密集碎片、马赛克式拼贴、厚重立体纸雕、矢量图标质感、摄影纹理填充胶带、粗描边、过多褶皱、杂乱手帐装饰，以及未经要求的票据、邮票、标签、胶带卷、剪刀、桌面道具、Logo、水印和无意义文字。

只输出完成的作品，保持主体可辨认、胶带质感可信、画面安静且留白充足。

recipe.effect: 参考胶带拼贴图案样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

默认只输出胶带重构作品，不把原照片放进成品。

【文字】
提供文字时准确使用；要求无文字时不添加。其他情况下，照片创作搭配一个描述可见主体的 1–3 词英文短标题，使用清晰、略带褪色感的打字机字体，放在主体附近但不重叠。不要编造地点、日期或身份。纯文字主题创作默认不加标题。

【避免】
密集碎片、马赛克式拼贴、厚重立体纸雕、矢量图标质感、摄影纹理填充胶带、粗描边、过多褶皱、杂乱手帐装饰，以及未经要求的票据、邮票、标签、胶带卷、剪刀、桌面道具、Logo、水印和无意义文字。

只输出完成的作品，保持主体可辨认、胶带质感可信、画面安静且留白充足。
promptLocales.en:
Transform the uploaded photo into a refined, restrained washi tape collage with an authentic handmade texture.

[Subject Distillation]
Identify the most important subject in the photo and retain 1–3 key identifying features, such as its silhouette, pose, structure, or characteristic colors. Reconstruct the subject using approximately 10–18 pieces of washi tape in moderate, varied widths. For complex scenes, retain only one core visual focal point; if needed, include 1–2 environmental elements from the original image, such as a ground color block, window panes, or a plant silhouette. Simplify details while keeping the subject recognizable.

[Tape Material]
The subject itself must be assembled from tape. Use mostly solid-colored tape, with a few striped, checked, or polka-dot pieces. Show fine matte paper fibers, slight translucency, soft fibrous edges, natural cuts, and a few torn edges. Overlapping areas should be slightly darker, with narrow contact shadows. Allow a few irregular seams, slight wrinkles, and lifted corners, while keeping the overall surface flat with shallow layers.

Use adjacent light, midtone, and dark tape color blocks to express volume and structure. Render details such as handles, stems, leaves, and edges using narrow tape, negative space, or overlapping seams, without pencil lines, ink lines, or drawn outlines.

[Color Palette]
Extract 4–6 harmonious, low-saturation colors from the original photo, adding at most one restrained warm accent color. Retain slight unevenness reminiscent of hand-dyed paper. Avoid smooth gradients, highly saturated clashing colors, and plastic gloss.

[Format & Composition]
By default, output a single 3:4 portrait artwork. Place the subject centrally and slightly below the midpoint, with a subtly asymmetric balance. The subject grouping should occupy approximately 40%–55% of the image width and 32%–48% of its height, leaving approximately 65%–80% quiet negative space. Keep the subject, shadows, and text at least approximately 9% of the image's shorter side away from the paper edges.

[Paper & Lighting]
The background is a single continuous, clean sheet of warm-white journal paper. Its surface should have subtle fibers that remain discernible at normal viewing size, slight undulations in the paper pulp, and a few irregular tiny specks. The texture should be low-contrast, natural, and non-repeating. Use soft, diffuse light with short, light shadows. Avoid yellowing, stains, large mottled patches, and excessive distressing.

[Original Photo Presentation]
By default, output only the tape reconstruction; do not include the original photo in the finished artwork.

[Text]
When text is provided, use it exactly; when no text is requested, add none. Otherwise, pair photo-based artwork with a short 1–3-word English title describing the visible subject. Use a clear, slightly faded typewriter font, placed near the subject without overlapping it. Do not invent locations, dates, or identities. For artwork based on a text-only theme, omit the title by default.

[Avoid]
Dense fragments, mosaic-style collage, thick three-dimensional paper sculpture, a vector-icon look, tape filled with photographic textures, heavy outlines, excessive wrinkles, cluttered journal decorations, and unrequested receipts, stamps, labels, tape rolls, scissors, tabletop props, logos, watermarks, or meaningless text.

Output only the finished artwork. Keep the subject recognizable, the tape texture convincing, and the composition quiet with ample negative space.

feishu-case-012.name: 摄影剪贴涂鸦风
feishu-case-012.style: 摄影剪贴涂鸦风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-012.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-012.originalPrompt:
[画幅与构图]
- 只输出一张接近 9:16 的竖版摄影剪贴涂鸦海报。整幅使用统一的暖米白色或取自原图的浅色纸底，主体集中在画面中下部，上方保留大面积留白。不拼接整张原照，不做分屏或前后对照。

[摄影剪贴与涂鸦]
- 从上传照片中提取最能讲述场景的主体和少量配件，去除多余背景。保留主体的真实颜色、纹理、姿态和比例，不拉伸、不变形。沿轮廓留下略不规则的浅色纸边，加一层很轻的投影，呈现手工剪贴在纸上的质感。
- 加入少量黑色手绘火柴人，让他们和照片主体发生具体、有趣的互动，例如坐上躺椅、扶住伞杆或攀爬树干。根据原图选择自然的动作，避免堆砌无关涂鸦。
- 在主体侧边的留白处加一句简短、俏皮的英文手写文案，可自然换行，不遮挡主体。用户指定文字时逐字保留；否则根据照片主题创作。

[质感与约束]
- 结合真实摄影、淡淡的纸张纹理和略带抖动的黑色笔触，整体干净、轻松，带独立杂志的手作感。
- 不添加边框、Logo、水印、复杂装饰或多余文字。

[可替换内容]
- 原图：[上传你要编辑的照片]
- 剪贴主体：[例如：棕榈树、遮阳伞、木质躺椅]
- 涂鸦互动：[例如：小人坐在躺椅上、扶住伞杆或攀着树干]
- 英文手写文案：[例如：“Even the palm tree is on vacation.”]

recipe.effect: 将原照的核心主体做成带浅色纸边和柔和阴影的摄影剪贴，在单张竖版纸面中下部加入与主体互动的黑线小人和英文手写短句，上方留白。

promptLocales.en:
[Format & Composition]
- Output a single vertical photo collage with doodles, approximately 9:16. Use one continuous warm off-white or photo-derived pale paper background. Place the collage in the middle to lower portion and leave generous negative space above. Do not insert the full original photo, divide the canvas into panels, or create a before-and-after comparison.

[Photo Cutouts & Doodles]
- Extract the main subject and a few supporting elements that tell the story of the uploaded photo. Remove the unnecessary background. Preserve their real colors, textures, poses, and proportions without stretching or distortion. Add slightly irregular pale paper edges and subtle drop shadows for a handmade cut-and-paste look.
- Add a few black hand-drawn stick figures that interact playfully with the photo cutouts, such as sitting on a lounge chair, holding an umbrella pole, or climbing a trunk. Choose actions that fit the source photo and avoid unrelated doodles.
- Add one short, playful handwritten English caption in the open space beside the subject. Allow natural line breaks and keep the caption clear of the subject. Preserve the user's exact wording when provided; otherwise write a line that fits the photo.

[Texture & Constraints]
- Combine real photography, subtle paper texture, and slightly uneven black ink strokes. Keep the composition clean and relaxed, with the handmade feel of an independent magazine.
- No borders, logos, watermarks, busy decoration, or extra text.

[Customizable Elements]
- Source photo: [Upload the photo you want to edit]
- Photo cutouts: [For example: a palm tree, a beach umbrella, and wooden lounge chairs]
- Doodle interaction: [For example: figures sitting on a chair, holding the umbrella pole, or climbing the trunk]
- Handwritten English caption: [For example: “Even the palm tree is on vacation.”]

feishu-case-025.originalPrompt:
#### 一、 全局硬性约束（Global Rules）
* **构图比例**：整体采用 **3:4 竖版构图**。
* **四分结构**：画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，比例严格为 **1:1:1:1**（各占25%），无缝衔接，无分隔线、无留白间隙。
* **核心一致性**：四层必须以同一张上传照片为唯一依据，严格保持主体身份、数量、关键结构、比例、姿态、动作方向、视线、观察视角、透视、遮挡、左右位置与前后关系一致。
* **去杂要求**：严禁添加层号、外边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo；除各层明确规定的少量排版文字外，不额外生成多余文字。

---

#### 二、 可配置变量参数（User Customization Variables）
> *💡 **使用说明**：复用此Prompt时，只需修改下方 `[ ]` 中的核心内容即可。*

* **`[INPUT_SUBJECT]`（核心主体）**：如：*露营房车、一对情侣与金毛犬、红皮独木舟、雪山湖泊*
* **`[THEME_TITLE]`（主题英文标题）**：如：*MOUNTAIN LAKE DAYS*
* **`[COLOR_TONE]`（色彩基调）**：如：*浅粉蓝、雾蓝、象牙白、鼠尾草绿*
* **`[TICKET_METADATA]`（票根关键信息）**：如：*DATE: 2024-05-18 | PLACE: MOUNTAIN LAKE | SUBJECT: Road Trip Day*

---

#### 三、 四层垂直结构化详细描述（Four-Layer Modular Prompt）

请将上传的摄影照片转化为一张四层同构的垂直海报，整体3:4比例，四层严格1:1:1:1等分，无缝衔接：

【第一层：原始摄影基准】
- 内容：直接保留上传照片真实摄影状态（主体：[INPUT_SUBJECT]）。
- 要求：不进行插画化、几何化。为适应约3:1扁横幅，仅做背景左右自然延展或轻微裁切，严禁拉伸主体或改变人物关系。画面清晰自然。

【第二层：选择性记忆贴纸重构】
- 构图：主视觉（还原[INPUT_SUBJECT]）+ 6枚记忆贴纸碎片（提取原图中的局部特征、物件、植物或细节，如树木、杯子、宠物特写等）。
- 风格：哑光水粉、剪纸拼贴、孔版印刷（Risograph）质感，带厚实浅色切边，错落分布，留有呼吸感。
- 配色：以[COLOR_TONE]的高级色系为主，保持轻盈统一。
- 文本：在留白处自由生成极少量克制、有意义的英文小标题或排版注释。

【第三层：水彩旅行票根明信片】
- 构图：居中悬置的横向水彩票根。左侧约74%为水彩主体画面，右侧约26%为几何信息票根，中间以竖向齿孔线精准分隔。
- 风格：高明度、低饱和水彩，笔触轻薄、纸张透白，带轻微边缘锯齿与自然阴影。
- 文本：右侧票根采用规范排版，包含字段：[TICKET_METADATA]，搭配编号、圆点、坐标数字及一枚圆形旅行印章。

【第四层：流金珐琅旅行冰箱贴】
- 构图：将主体重构为一枚精致的流金珐琅旅行徽章/冰箱贴，置于大面积纯色留白背景中央。
- 风格：真实珐琅填色 + 金属分隔线 + 清晰白色金属外描边，边缘带适度厚度、圆润倒角与立体投影。
- 文本：徽章底部制作金属铭牌，嵌入短英文标题：[THEME_TITLE]。

promptLocales.en:
#### I. Global Rules
* **Aspect ratio**: Overall **3:4 portrait composition**.
* **Four-part structure**: Divide the image from top to bottom into four strictly equal horizontal regions, in a **1:1:1:1** ratio (25% each), joined seamlessly with no dividing lines or blank gaps.
* **Core consistency**: All four layers must use the same uploaded photo as their sole reference. Strictly preserve subject identity, count, key structures, proportions, poses, action direction, gaze, viewing angle, perspective, occlusion, left/right placement, and front/back relationships.
* **No clutter**: No layer numbers, outer borders, collage gaps, watermarks, or logos. Generate no extra text beyond the small amount of typography explicitly specified for each layer.

---

#### II. User Customization Variables
> *💡 **Instructions**: To reuse this prompt, edit only the core content in `[ ]` below.*

* **`[INPUT_SUBJECT]` (core subject)**: e.g., *a camper van, a couple and a golden retriever, a red canoe, a lake beneath snowy mountains*
* **`[THEME_TITLE]` (English theme title)**: e.g., *MOUNTAIN LAKE DAYS*
* **`[COLOR_TONE]` (color scheme)**: e.g., *pale pastel blue, misty blue, ivory, sage green*
* **`[TICKET_METADATA]` (key ticket information)**: e.g., *DATE: 2024-05-18 | PLACE: MOUNTAIN LAKE | SUBJECT: Road Trip Day*

---

#### III. Four-Layer Modular Description

Transform the uploaded photograph into a vertical poster with four structurally corresponding layers. Overall ratio 3:4; layers strictly equal in a 1:1:1:1 ratio, joined seamlessly:

[Layer 1: Original Photographic Reference]
- Content: Directly retain the uploaded photo's realistic photographic state (subject: [INPUT_SUBJECT]).
- Requirements: No illustration or geometrization. To fit the approximately 3:1 shallow horizontal strip, only naturally extend the background left/right or crop slightly. Never stretch the subject or alter relationships between people. Keep the image clear and natural.

[Layer 2: Selective Memory Sticker Reconstruction]
- Composition: Main visual (recreating [INPUT_SUBJECT]) + 6 memory-sticker fragments (extract local features, objects, plants, or details from the original, such as trees, cups, pet close-ups).
- Style: Matte gouache, paper-cut collage, and Risograph texture, with thick light-colored cut edges, irregular placement, and breathing room.
- Palette: Primarily the sophisticated colors of [COLOR_TONE], light and unified.
- Text: Freely generate very few restrained, meaningful small English headings or editorial notes in the negative space.

[Layer 3: Watercolor Travel Ticket Postcard]
- Composition: A horizontal watercolor ticket suspended centrally. Approximately 74% on the left contains the watercolor subject; approximately 26% on the right is a geometric information stub, precisely separated by a vertical perforation line.
- Style: High-value, low-saturation watercolor, light brushwork, translucent paper whites, slightly serrated edges, and natural shadows.
- Text: Standardized typography on the right stub, including fields: [TICKET_METADATA], with numbering, dots, coordinate numbers, and a circular travel stamp.

[Layer 4: Gilded Enamel Travel Fridge Magnet]
- Composition: Reconstruct the subject as a refined gilded enamel travel badge/fridge magnet, centered against a large expanse of plain-color negative space.
- Style: Real enamel fills + metal dividing lines + a clear white metal outer outline, with moderately thick edges, rounded bevels, and three-dimensional cast shadows.
- Text: A metal nameplate at the bottom of the badge containing the short English title: [THEME_TITLE].

3D可爱玩偶风格（Cute 3D art toy style），结合精致插画质感（illustration texture combined with 3D）。外观为立体卡通公仔，具备真实的半透明塑料 blister pack（吸塑包装）外壳、顶部挂钩（hang tag）和精美纸卡边框（cardboard backing）。柔和温暖的棚拍光线，表面带有细腻的塑料和树脂质感，整体现代、精致、温暖且略带俏皮感。

【画面布局与元素（左主右配）】

背景（Background）：包装内部纸卡背景采用：[输入核心地标或场景，例如：新加坡滨海湾金沙酒店及天际线]。

左侧主体（Main Character）：基于参考图的人物特征、动作与穿搭生成。Q版立体玩偶造型，突出可爱生动的面部表情，穿着：[描述服装颜色与款式，例如：深蓝色短袖T恤、深色短裤、运动鞋]，做 [动作描述，例如：比V手势]。

右侧配件（Accessories，严格限制数量）：透明塑料隔层内右侧仅摆放以下 3 个固定配件（严格控制数量，不要有多余杂物）：

[配件1：例如 鱼尾狮雕像]

[配件2：例如 富士一次性胶片相机]

[配件3：例如 蓝色雨伞]

【顶部文字标签】

包装顶部纸卡正中央印有醒目的定制英文字母大写文字：[YOUR_NAME，例如：XIAOTIAO]，字体清晰现代。

【画面规格】

画面比例 3:4，构图严谨，元素间比例协调。

promptLocales.en:
[Overall Style & Materials]
Cute 3D art toy style, combining refined illustration texture with 3D. A three-dimensional cartoon figurine in a realistic translucent plastic blister pack, with a top hang tag and an attractive cardboard backing border. Soft, warm studio lighting, delicate plastic and resin surface textures; modern, refined, warm, and slightly playful overall.

[Layout & Elements: Main Figure Left, Accessories Right]

Background: The interior backing card depicts [enter a key landmark or scene, e.g., Singapore's Marina Bay Sands hotel and skyline].

Main Character (left): Based on the reference person's features, action, and outfit. A chibi 3D toy with a cute, lively facial expression, wearing [describe clothing colors and styles, e.g., a dark blue short-sleeved T-shirt, dark shorts, sneakers], making [describe action, e.g., a V sign].

Accessories (right, strictly limited count): Place only the following 3 fixed accessories in transparent plastic compartments on the right (strictly control the count, no extra clutter):

[Accessory 2: e.g., a Fujifilm disposable film camera]

[Accessory 3: e.g., a blue umbrella]

[Top Text Label]

Print prominent customized uppercase English lettering at the top center of the backing card: [YOUR_NAME, e.g., XIAOTIAO], in a clear, modern font.

[Image Specifications]

Aspect ratio 3:4, rigorous composition and harmonious proportions between elements.

feishu-case-029.originalPrompt:
[Style/Medium]:
A clumsy, scribbly, low-quality digital drawing made in MS Paint with a mouse, featuring a pixel-by-pixel, awkward, and ridiculously bad aesthetic.

[Subject & Composition]:
Redraw the attached image ([描述主体，例如：Two cats sleeping on a pink bed with a blue and grey blanket]). The composition should be vaguely similar but off in a confusing, disproportionate way.

[Color & Palette]:
Strictly use the same color palette as the original image ([指定主色调，例如：pastel pink bedsheets, cream-and-grey cat, black-and-white cat, blue blanket]).

[Line Work & Details]:
Wobbly, erratic freehand brush strokes, jagged pixel edges, messy crayon-like or pencil-like scribbles, omitting fine details while keeping the general silhouette recognizable.

promptLocales.zh-CN:
[风格/媒介]：
用鼠标在 MS Paint 中画出的笨拙、潦草、低质量数字绘画，呈现逐像素绘制、别扭且糟糕得可笑的美感。

[主体与构图]：
重绘所附图片（[描述主体，例如：两只猫睡在粉色床铺上，盖着蓝灰色毯子]）。构图应大致相似，但以令人困惑、比例失调的方式偏离原图。

[色彩与配色]：
严格使用与原图相同的配色（[指定主色调，例如：粉彩粉色床单、奶油色与灰色相间的猫、黑白猫、蓝色毯子]）。

[线条与细节]：
摇晃、不规则的徒手笔触，锯齿状像素边缘，凌乱的蜡笔或铅笔般涂画；省略精细细节，同时保持整体轮廓可辨认。

feishu-case-022.originalPrompt:
[任务与身份一致性]
根据上传人物参考图，制作一张约 2:3 竖版专业角色设定表。所有视图中的脸型、五官、发型、头身比、体型、服装、鞋履、配饰和颜色均属于同一角色，保留年龄感、肤色、眼睛颜色、发际线、服装缝线与图案，以及配饰的准确位置和左右关系；保留原有痣、疤痕及其他辨识标记的位置与形态，不新增标记；不重新设计、美化、增龄或减龄。

[版式与八个模块]
使用暖白背景、细分隔线和清楚的编号标题，按以下层次排版：
01 — HERO PORTRAIT：左上为较大的头肩肖像。
02 — FULL-BODY TURNAROUND：右上横向排列正面、前侧 3/4、侧面、后侧 3/4、背面五个等比例全身视图，采用统一的中性站姿，头顶、眼线、肩、腰、髋、膝与脚底横向对齐。
03 — EXPRESSION STUDY：中部左侧为两行三列头像，分别表现中性、浅笑、严肃、生气、惊讶、悲伤。六张头像采用一致的头肩取景、头部大小和视角；只改变表情肌肉与眼口状态，不夸张拉伸或改变面部构造。
04 — SIGNATURE POSE STUDIES：中部右侧为四个全身姿态，包含站立、行走或坐姿等符合角色气质的动作。
05 — COSTUME & DETAIL CALLOUTS：下部左侧展示头发、领口、腰带、鞋履等实际存在的细节。
06 — MATERIAL STUDIES：下部中间展示来自原图的主要材质及配饰特写。
07 — COLOR PALETTE：位于 05、06 下方，为一排主要色块，按肤色、发色、主服装、次服装、点缀色、配饰与材质色组织。颜色直接对应参考人物，保留主次关系，不添加无关色。
08 — PROPORTION & SILHOUETTE GUIDE：右下为一张全身比例示意与一枚清楚的实心黑色剪影。绘出整体高度标尺、头身比及眼线、肩、腰、髋、膝、脚底的水平参考线，标示关键身体比例；技术线细淡，不压过人物。

[绘制与文字]
使用柔和均匀的中性棚拍光和受控阴影，准确表现皮肤、头发、织物、皮革和金属等原图材质的纹理与反射差异；转面图接近正交视角，动作图保持合理解剖。采用干净精确的专业视觉开发渲染，皮肤与头发自然，细节清楚但不过锐。模块沿统一网格对齐、间距均衡、标题层级一致。模块标题按上述英文原样呈现，其他标签简短、可读。保留原角色比例，不强制套用固定头身比。

[约束]
整页仅包含上述八个模块，各模块保持同一角色设计。不增加角色没有的服装或配饰，不裁掉全身视图，不重叠人物，不添加水印或装饰性背景。

recipe.effect: 参考角色设计参考表样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and identity]
Create an approximately 2:3 portrait professional character reference sheet from the uploaded character image. Every view must retain the same facial structure, features, hair, head-to-body ratio, physique, costume, footwear, accessories and colors. Preserve apparent age, skin tone, eye color, hairline, costume seams and patterns, accessory placement and left/right asymmetries. Retain the position and shape of any existing moles, scars and other identity marks; invent no marks. Do not redesign, beautify, age or de-age the character.

[Layout: eight modules]
Use a warm-white ground, fine dividers and clear numbered headings:
01 — HERO PORTRAIT: a large head-and-shoulders portrait at upper left.
02 — FULL-BODY TURNAROUND: five equally scaled full-body views across the upper right: front, front three-quarter, profile, back three-quarter and back. Use the same neutral standing pose and align head tops, eyes, shoulders, waist, hips, knees and feet horizontally.
03 — EXPRESSION STUDY: a two-row, three-column head grid at middle left: neutral, subtle smile, serious, angry, surprised and sad. Use consistent head-and-shoulders framing, head size and viewing angle. Change only facial acting and eye/mouth states, without exaggerated stretching or altered facial construction.
04 — SIGNATURE POSE STUDIES: four full-body poses at middle right, including appropriate standing, walking or seated actions.
05 — COSTUME & DETAIL CALLOUTS: lower-left close-ups of actual features such as hair, collar, belt and footwear.
06 — MATERIAL STUDIES: lower-middle samples of the source's principal materials and accessories.
07 — COLOR PALETTE: a horizontal swatch strip below modules 05 and 06, organized by skin, hair, primary costume, secondary costume, accents, and accessories/materials. Match the reference colors and their hierarchy; add no unrelated colors.
08 — PROPORTION & SILHOUETTE GUIDE: a full-body proportion study and one clear solid-black silhouette at bottom right. Show overall height, head-to-body ratio, horizontal guides for eyes, shoulders, waist, hips, knees and feet, and key body proportions. Keep technical rules faint and subordinate to the figure.

[Rendering and labels]
Use soft, even neutral studio lighting and controlled shadows. Accurately distinguish the source materials through their textures and reflections, including skin, hair, fabric, leather and metal where present. Turnarounds use near-orthographic framing; poses remain anatomically plausible. Use clean, precise professional visual-development rendering, natural skin and hair, and crisp detail without oversharpening. Align modules to a consistent grid with balanced spacing and a unified heading hierarchy. Render the module headings exactly as written above; keep other labels short and legible. Preserve the source character's proportions rather than imposing a fixed head count.

[Constraints]
Include exactly the eight modules listed above, with the same character design throughout. No invented costume pieces or accessories, cropped full-body views, overlapping figures, watermark or decorative scenery.

feishu-case-032.name: 建筑线稿风
feishu-case-032.style: 建筑线稿风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-032.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-032.originalPrompt:
[核心任务]
将输入图像转化为后数字时代（Post-digital）建筑插画风格。严格保持原图的建筑结构、空间布局、透视角度及所有画面元素的位置完全一致。

[1. 核心艺术风格]
- 风格定义：精致细线稿（Fine line art）结合扁平平涂（Flat color blocking），融合现代建筑拼贴风（Architectural collage style）。
- 画面密度：构图饱满充实，拒绝大面积空旷留白。

[2. 画面层次与细节要求]
- 地面与前景：
  * 地面铺满极细线稿绘制的广场铺装纹理。
  * 散落丰富的插画风前景植物（如：大叶绿植、低矮灌木）、木质座椅及扁平化人物配景，填满画面底部。
- 背景与天空：
  * 天空区域完全填充，叠加扁平的远树剪影或极简云朵，营造深邃丰满的背景。
- 建筑立面细节：
  * 立面覆盖密集的极细竖向线条（竖向格栅）。
  * 玻璃幕墙透出丰富的室内结构与活动场景，避免表面出现大块空洞的纯白。
- 线条处理：
  * 所有建筑、植物（前景与背景）的边缘必须保留极细、精致的描边。

[3. 严格低饱和度配色方案]
- 背景与天空：薄荷灰绿 [可替换色值/描述]
- 建筑主体：暖白（布满密集线条细节） [可替换色值/描述]
- 建筑天花板与挑空连廊：珊瑚橘粉 [可替换色值/描述]
- 植物与树木（含前景）：深森绿与浅豆绿交织 [可替换色值/描述]

[4. 可替换参数区（用户自定义）]
- 建筑类型：[例如：现代办公园区 / 综合商业街区 / 校园公共空间]
- 核心材质：[例如：竖向金属格栅 / 玻璃幕墙 / 混凝土]
- 空间氛围：[例如：充满活力的日间 / 绿意盎然的社区]

recipe.effect: 参考建筑线稿风样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
[Core Task]
Transform the input image into a post-digital architectural illustration. Strictly preserve the original architectural structure, spatial layout, perspective, and exact positions of all image elements.

[1. Core Art Style]
- Style: Refined fine line art combined with flat color blocking and modern architectural collage.
- Image density: Full, rich composition; avoid large empty areas of negative space.

[2. Layers & Detail Requirements]
- Ground & foreground:
  * Cover the ground with plaza paving textures drawn in extremely fine lines.
  * Scatter abundant illustrated foreground plants (large-leaf greenery, low shrubs), wooden seating, and flat human figures across the bottom to fill it.
- Background & sky:
  * Fill the sky completely, overlaying flat distant-tree silhouettes or minimalist clouds for a deep, full background.
- Facade details:
  * Cover facades with dense, extremely fine vertical lines (vertical louvers).
  * Show rich interior structures and activity through glass curtain walls; avoid large empty pure-white surfaces.
- Line treatment:
  * Retain extremely fine, refined outlines along all architectural and plant edges (foreground and background).

[3. Strict Low-Saturation Palette]
- Background & sky: Mint gray-green [replaceable color value/description]
- Main architecture: Warm white (filled with dense line details) [replaceable color value/description]
- Ceilings & elevated open corridors: Coral orange-pink [replaceable color value/description]
- Plants & trees (including foreground): Interwoven deep forest green and pale bean green [replaceable color value/description]

[4. User Customization Variables]
- Building type: [e.g., a modern office campus / mixed-use commercial district / campus public space]
- Core materials: [e.g., vertical metal louvers / glass curtain walls / concrete]
- Spatial atmosphere: [e.g., lively daytime / a verdant community]

[Global Settings]
- Canvas Ratio: 3:4 portrait format
- Layout: Divide the image into equal upper and lower blocks, each occupying 50% of the total height
- Core Concept: Generate each image as an independent poster; strictly prohibit combining multiple photos. Present sophisticated magazine-level symmetric aesthetics

[Top Section: Realism & Editorial Grade]
- Content: Fully preserve the original main subject; retain the appearance and body shape of people/objects, structural proportions, realistic textures, original light and shadow, and color atmosphere
- Treatment: Apply only refined high-end color adjustments for the quality of art magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography
- Background: Naturally extend the sky, ground, or surrounding environment as appropriate; never stretch, deform, or change the subject

[Bottom Section: 3D Impasto Miniature Illustration]
- Transformation: Extract the original's most recognizable core theme, subject silhouette, and narrative, recreating them as a 3D impasto oil-painted miniature landscape illustration
- Composition: Use large areas of negative space, with the subject centered or slightly offset along a diagonal visual axis
- Background Base: Bright white paper with subtle texture; support the subject with a translucent impasto color band derived from the original (which may become water, a path, a light band, ground, or an abstract section)
- Interactivity & Details: Integrate the subject naturally with the color band, accenting it with reflections, ripples, light spots, extended brushstrokes, clouds, light beams, mist, and other natural elements to create an airy poetic space

[Artistic Style & Texture]
- Visual Style: Impasto oil-paint texture + three-dimensional miniature scenery + luminous soft light
- Texture Details: Clearly visible layered pigment, palette-knife scrapes, raised color-block edges, and handmade paper texture; emphasize impasto on water, clouds, light bands, and highlights for tangible tactility

[Color Scheme & Palette]
- Primary Tone: Extract and remix the original's vivid, bright, lively high-saturation colors, raising overall brightness and color purity
- Recommended Palette: [Enter main colors, e.g., clear sky blue, lake green, leafy green, warm yellow, coral orange, peach pink, and other natural colors]
- Atmosphere: Balance cool and warm tones, with large clean warm-white negative spaces and local warm-orange/golden sunlight accents, conveying sunny freshness, warmth, lightness, energy, and comfort
- Negative Constraints: No dark muddy tones, faded bland filters, low-saturation Morandi grays, dark brown retro filters, harsh fluorescent colors, or cheap oversaturated candy palettes

[User Customization Variables]
- [Original subject description]: Replace with the core subject of your uploaded image (e.g., a young cyclist and two running puppies)
- [Core palette]: Replace with the desired color emphasis (e.g., sunny sky blue and leafy green)
- [Decorative text/slogan]: Replace with the typography needed in the lower illustration (e.g., Ride into The Blue / Summer lives in every road)

[Format & Layout]
- Aspect ratio: 3:4 vertical art diptych poster

- Treatment: Allow adaptive local structural rearrangement; maintain a clean image and add no text

- Main title:
  * Text: Automatically generate or specify [a 3–6-letter English word, e.g., STYLE]
  * Letterforms: Ultra-bold condensed experimental type, applying 70% nonlinear scaling and center-offset compensation
  * Embedding: Embed photographic content within the letters using multilayer dynamic masks. Use interleaved depth-of-field mapping to make the subject break out of the frame; allow local discontinuous contour fusion

[Detail & Texture Accents]
- Decorative elements: Add a few thematic paper cutouts, handwritten strokes (e.g., [enter handwritten subtitle, such as: Be Bold]), screen-print grain, and micro editorial text
- Style: Cinematic texture, experimental type, spatial displacement, masterful editorial typography
- Output: Automatically adjust details to the subject's mood; output only one high-quality finished image

feishu-case-039.originalPrompt:
# 极简手绘旅行海报

将上传的照片重绘为一张约 4:7 的竖版手绘插画海报。以整张暖米白色纹理纸作为连续画布，顶部约三分之一只留纸面。把插画集中在中下部，四周和底部留出自然的纸边。整幅画面用统一的手绘语言呈现，避免照片拼贴和分栏。

## 主体与构图

- 从原图提取辨识度最高的主体、辅助元素和地点特征，保留它们的轮廓、主要色彩与前后关系。简化杂乱细节，用大小、疏密和留白组织层次。
- 以一个主要主体建立视觉焦点，将较小的元素疏落地排在一侧，地景在画面下方自然收束。若输入是卡帕多奇亚气球照片，让赭红与奶油色条纹的大气球略偏左居中，几只小气球向左错落，岩峰压低到背景，橙色越野车落在右下前景。

## 纸面、线条与色彩

- 使用轻微不规则的细墨线、水彩薄涂和少量哑光色块。保留纸纤维、细颗粒和手绘边缘，远处的山形与地面笔触渐淡融入纸面。

promptLocales.en:
# Minimalist Hand-Drawn Travel Poster

Redraw the uploaded photo as a portrait hand-drawn illustration poster at approximately 4:7. Use a continuous sheet of warm off-white textured paper as the canvas, leaving roughly the top third as bare paper. Concentrate the illustration in the middle and lower area, with natural paper margins around the sides and bottom. Use a unified hand-drawn language throughout, avoiding photographic collage and divided panels.

## Subject & Composition

- Extract the most recognizable subject, supporting elements, and location features from the original, preserving their silhouettes, main colors, and front-to-back relationships. Simplify clutter and organize hierarchy through size, density, and negative space.
- Establish a focal point with one main subject, scatter smaller elements to one side, and let the landscape resolve naturally toward the bottom. If the input is a Cappadocia balloon photo, place a large ochre-red and cream striped balloon slightly left of center, stagger several smaller balloons toward the left, keep rocky peaks low in the background, and place an orange off-road vehicle in the lower-right foreground.

## Paper, Lines & Color

- Use fine, slightly irregular ink lines, thin watercolor washes, and a few matte color blocks. Retain paper fibers, fine grain, and hand-drawn edges; distant mountains and ground strokes gradually fade into the paper.
- Extract a small set of low-saturation primary colors from the original. For the balloon example, use terracotta red, sandstone beige, gray-blue-green, and warm orange, with dark brown or charcoal details. The overall effect is warm and quiet, like the cover of an independent travel publication.

## Optional Copy

When text is needed, place a short text group in the negative space to the right of the main visual. Use dark condensed capitals for the title, followed by one or two small lines with expanded tracking. Preserve clear subject-related markings from the original, and reproduce user-specified copy verbatim. This example may retain KAYAKAPI on the balloon and use the three lines KAYAKAPI, CAPPADOCIA, PREMIUM CAVES on the right. For other scenes, replace or omit the copy as needed.

Avoid complex backgrounds, dense text, heavy oil-paint strokes, plastic shine, and 3D rendering.

feishu-case-045.originalPrompt:
# 3:4 竖版高级旅行编辑海报生成指令 (Modular Travel Journal Poster Prompt)

## 0. 核心定位与总则 (Core Principle)
- **输出格式**：严格 3:4 竖版单图。禁止多图拼接、并列或九宫格。
- **核心结构**：上下 1:1 对照结构（上半部分：高保真真实摄影；下半部分：克制的高级旅行手帐解构）。中间由一条笔直、清晰、干净的水平线分隔（无渐变、无撕纸、无元素互侵）。
- **审美基调**：真实旅行摄影 × 日本文具店克制美学 × 编辑式设计。清新、安静、松弛、高级。

---

## 1. 上半区｜高保真旅行摄影 (Top Half: High-Fidelity Photography)
- **内容要求**：完整保留用户上传的原始摄影（主体、姿态、构图、光影、天气、空间关系），不作插画化重绘。
- **后期处理**：仅限出版物级微调（自然、干净、通透、克制），无强滤镜。

---

## 2. 下半区｜旅行记忆解构与手帐拼贴 (Bottom Half: Journal Editing & Deconstruction)
- **纸张质感**：自然暖白 / 软奶油白（Warm Ivory / Soft Natural White），带极其轻微的天然纸纤维。严禁泛黄、强复古、做旧、茶染或污渍。
- **大面积留白**：下半区必须保留 **35%–50% 的连续纸白**（呼吸感），根据原图重心选择留白方向（左/右/顶/底）。
- **视觉层级 (Hierarchy)**：
  1. **主层级 (1张)**：主视觉明信片（宽度占下半区 48%–65%），经构图简化、扁平化与色彩提炼的高级商业插画。哑光印刷纸质感。
  2. **次层级 (2–3个)**：记忆元素贴纸/插画（如模切白边贴纸、小型插画、局部小卡片）。
  3. **第三层级 (1–3个)**：极少量微型点缀（色票、编号小标签、细和纸胶带、手写短句）。

---

## 3. 动态参数变量区（用户自定义修改区）
> 💡 **提示：生成新图时，只需根据当前照片修改以下 `{{变量}}` 内容。**

- **`{{PHOTO_SCENE_TYPE}}`**：当前照片场景类型（例如：海边车站与电车 / 城市街角 / 山地草原 / 餐厅美食等）
- **`{{PRIMARY_POSTCARD_CONTENT}}`**：下半区主明信片提炼的核心画面（例如：带有绿皮电车与海平面的平交道口）
- **`{{MEMORY_STICKERS}}`**：提取的 2-3 个独立记忆贴纸元素（例如：1. 带有白边的绿皮电车模切贴纸；2. 绣球花植物贴纸；3. 当地色卡小纸片）
- **`{{HANDWRITTEN_NOTE}}`**：私人日记感手写英文短句（克制、松弛，不超过 1 行。例如："The sea was unusually calm that day."）
- **`{{COLOR_PALETTE}}`**：从原图中提取的 3-5 个核心低饱和度色彩（例如：柔和粉蓝、鼠尾草绿、浅燕麦色、奶油灰）

---

## 4. 严禁事项 (Negative Constraints)
- 禁止过黄纸张、强 vintage 滤镜、满版堆砌素材。
- 禁止全员统一白边、所有素材围成一圈或呈“电商素材展示板”感。
- 禁止凭空捏造与当前旅行无关的假机票、假护照、假经纬度、假邮戳。
- 禁止广告 slogan 式夸张口号。

> 💡 **提示：生成新图时，只需根据当前照片修改以下 `{{变量}}` 内容。**

- **`{{PHOTO_SCENE_TYPE}}`**：当前照片场景类型（例如：海边车站与电车 / 城市街角 / 山地草原 / 餐厅美食等）
- **`{{PRIMARY_POSTCARD_CONTENT}}`**：下半区主明信片提炼的核心画面（例如：带有绿皮电车与海平面的平交道口）
- **`{{MEMORY_STICKERS}}`**：提取的 2-3 个独立记忆贴纸元素（例如：1. 带有白边的绿皮电车模切贴纸；2. 绣球花植物贴纸；3. 当地色卡小纸片）
- **`{{HANDWRITTEN_NOTE}}`**：私人日记感手写英文短句（克制、松弛，不超过 1 行。例如："The sea was unusually calm that day."）
- **`{{COLOR_PALETTE}}`**：从原图中提取的 3-5 个核心低饱和度色彩（例如：柔和粉蓝、鼠尾草绿、浅燕麦色、奶油灰）

---

## 4. 严禁事项 (Negative Constraints)
- 禁止过黄纸张、强 vintage 滤镜、满版堆砌素材。
- 禁止全员统一白边、所有素材围成一圈或呈“电商素材展示板”感。
- 禁止凭空捏造与当前旅行无关的假机票、假护照、假经纬度、假邮戳。
- 禁止广告 slogan 式夸张口号。
promptLocales.en:
# 3:4 Vertical High-End Travel Editorial Poster Prompt

## 0. Core Principle
- **Output**: Strictly one 3:4 portrait image. No multi-image stitching, side-by-side outputs, or nine-panel grids.
- **Core structure**: A 1:1 top/bottom comparison (upper half: high-fidelity real photography; lower half: restrained, sophisticated travel-journal deconstruction). Separate the halves with a straight, clear, clean horizontal line (no gradient, torn paper, or elements crossing between halves).
- **Aesthetic**: Real travel photography × restrained Japanese stationery-shop aesthetics × editorial design. Fresh, quiet, relaxed, refined.

---

## 1. Top Half: High-Fidelity Travel Photography
- **Content**: Fully preserve the user's original photograph (subject, pose, composition, light and shadow, weather, spatial relationships), without redrawing it as an illustration.
- **Post-processing**: Only publication-level fine adjustments (natural, clean, luminous, restrained); no strong filters.

---

## 2. Bottom Half: Travel Memory Deconstruction & Journal Collage
- **Paper texture**: Natural warm white / soft cream white (Warm Ivory / Soft Natural White) with extremely subtle natural paper fibers. No yellowing, strong retro treatment, distressing, tea stains, or marks.
- **Large negative space**: Retain **35%–50% continuous paper white** in the lower half for breathing room. Choose the direction of negative space (left/right/top/bottom) based on the original photo's center of gravity.
- **Visual hierarchy**:
  1. **Primary (1 item)**: A main visual postcard (48%–65% of the lower section's width), a sophisticated commercial illustration with simplified composition, flattened forms, and distilled colors. Matte printed-paper texture.
  2. **Secondary (2–3 items)**: Memory stickers/illustrations (e.g., die-cut white-border stickers, small illustrations, small detail cards).
  3. **Tertiary (1–3 items)**: Very few miniature accents (color swatches, numbered tags, thin washi tape, handwritten short phrases).

---

## 3. User Customization Variables
> 💡 **Tip: For a new image, edit only the following `{{variables}}` to match the current photo.**

- **`{{PHOTO_SCENE_TYPE}}`**: Current photo's scene type (e.g., seaside station and tram / city street corner / mountain grassland / restaurant food)
- **`{{PRIMARY_POSTCARD_CONTENT}}`**: Core scene distilled into the lower main postcard (e.g., a railway crossing with a green tram and the sea horizon)
- **`{{MEMORY_STICKERS}}`**: 2-3 independent extracted memory-sticker elements (e.g., 1. a green tram die-cut sticker with white border; 2. a hydrangea sticker; 3. a small local color-swatch paper)
- **`{{HANDWRITTEN_NOTE}}`**: A personal diary-like handwritten English phrase (restrained, relaxed, no more than 1 line; e.g., "The sea was unusually calm that day.")
- **`{{COLOR_PALETTE}}`**: 3-5 core low-saturation colors extracted from the original (e.g., soft pastel blue, sage green, pale oatmeal, cream gray)

---

## 4. Negative Constraints
- No overly yellow paper, strong vintage filters, or material covering every inch.
- No uniform white borders on every element, arranging everything in a ring, or an e-commerce asset-display-board look.
- Do not invent fake flight tickets, passports, coordinates, or postmarks unrelated to this trip.
- No exaggerated advertising slogans.

feishu-case-046.originalPrompt:
[任务与构图]
把上传照片中的主要主体及少量关键环境转化为一件立体微缩摆件。输出一张 3:2 横版模型展示图，不拼接原始照片。模型位于画面中央略偏下，置于圆角方形浅米色底座上，从斜上方观看，底座四边完整可见。四周保留明显留白，模型最高点上方的空白大于底座下方的空白；背景为干净、浅淡的暖色单色。

[主体提炼]
保留主要人物或动物的数量、姿态、朝向和相互关系；建筑、器物简化为柔和厚实体块。只选能说明主题的植物、地形或水景，不复刻整个真实背景，也不额外增加装饰角色。

[材质与层次]
人物和动物呈圆润的小手办形态，表面细腻哑光；植物、食物和环境细节统一为细腻哑光软陶，体积柔和。仅在原图包含水景时，在底座内嵌入一小片水面，以浅蓝或原图水色表现少量简洁波纹；无水景时保留与原场景对应的地面。各元素真实接触底座，接触处有细微阴影。

[配色与光线]
配色从输入图提取，适度提亮并降低饱和度。使用柔和棚拍漫射光，形成温暖、安静的收藏摆件质感。背景无地平线和真实场景细节。

[约束]
不添加文字、标志或边框；不裁切模型与底座，不出现强镜面反射、塑料高光、写实皮毛、过度写实的表面纹理或照片对照区。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and composition]
Turn the uploaded photograph's principal subjects and a few key environmental elements into one miniature ornament. Output a 3:2 landscape product-style model image without an original-photo panel. Place the model slightly below center on a pale-beige rounded-square base, viewed obliquely from above. Show all base edges with clear surrounding whitespace. Leave more empty space above its highest point than below the base, against a clean, pale, solid warm-colored background.

[Subject selection]
Preserve the count, poses, directions and relationships of the main people or animals. Simplify buildings and objects into soft, substantial volumes. Include only plants, terrain or water needed to explain the scene; do not reproduce the entire photographic background or add decorative characters.

[Materials and depth]
People and animals become rounded figurines with fine matte surfaces. Give vegetation, food and environmental details fine matte modeling-clay surfaces and soft volume. Only when the source contains water, inset a small water area into the base using pale blue or the source water color and a few simple ripples. Otherwise use ground corresponding to the original scene. Every element physically meets the base with subtle contact shadows.

[Palette and light]
Extract colors from the input, gently increasing brightness and reducing saturation. Use soft diffused studio lighting for a warm, quiet collectible appearance. Keep the background free of a horizon line and real-scene detail.

[Constraints]
No text, logo or border. Do not crop the model or base. Avoid strong mirror reflections, plastic highlights, realistic fur, excessively photorealistic surface textures and photo comparison panels.

feishu-case-047.name: 人物水彩速写
feishu-case-047.style: 人物水彩速写。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。

feishu-case-047.originalPrompt:
[任务与主体]
将上传人物照片改编为一幅极简日系钢笔与透明水彩结合的非写实动画风速写插画。保留原图人物的脸型、五官比例、发型发色、神态、视线、姿态、服装配色和手中关键物件。采用 3:2 横版，人物保持原图可见范围和动作关系。

[线条]
使用纤细、自然、松散的钢笔线勾勒。保留断续、重复和未闭合轮廓；五官用少量线条概括，仍可辨认同一人物。头发线条沿原分缝与生长方向，不做精密写实描摹。

[透明水彩]
头发以原色系浅淡薄涂，留出未上色区域。皮肤大面积留白，仅在脸颊、鼻尖、嘴唇点染少量红晕。服装取原图一至两种关键颜色，以松散、不均匀的色块局部上色；不要把整个人物完全填满。保留自然晕染和轻微颗粒。

[背景与完成度]
使用纯白纸面，将背景简化为极少量提示场景的细线，人物边缘局部消散到留白中。线条为主、水彩为辅，画面轻盈、有未完成感。无需新增标题或文字。

[约束]
避免厚涂、复杂阴影、完整照片背景、过度精细纹理、数字磨皮和水印。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and subject]
Transform the uploaded portrait into a minimalist Japanese pen-and-transparent-watercolor sketch with non-photorealistic animated-character styling. Preserve the actual face shape, feature proportions, hair, expression, gaze, pose, clothing colors and important held objects. Use a 3:2 landscape canvas while retaining the visible body extent and action relationships.

[Linework]
Draw with fine, natural, loose pen strokes. Retain interrupted, repeated and open contours. Describe facial features with few marks while keeping the person recognizable. Follow the original hair part and growth directions without precise photographic tracing.

[Transparent watercolor]
Apply pale washes in the original hair color, leaving some areas unpainted. Keep most skin white, adding only slight blush to cheeks, nose and lips. Pick one or two key clothing colors from the source and apply loose, uneven local washes. Do not completely fill the figure. Retain natural bleeding and slight granulation.

[Background and finish]
Use white paper and reduce the setting to a very small number of contextual fine lines. Let some figure edges dissolve into whitespace. Linework leads and watercolor supports, with a light, unfinished quality. No added headline or text is needed.

[Constraints]
Avoid impasto, complex shadows, a full photographic background, excessively precise textures, digital skin smoothing and watermarks.

feishu-case-048.name: 现代绘本风
feishu-case-048.style: 现代绘本风。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。

feishu-case-048.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片转换成一幅 3:2 横版现代绘本生活方式插画。整幅统一绘制，不嵌入原始照片，不采用上下对照布局。

[人物与场景保留]
照片是人物身份、姿态、表情、视线、发型、服装、配饰、重要物件和环境关系的依据。保持拍摄视角、人物在画面中的相对位置与大小、身体朝向、可见范围及关键动作，使人物始终成为清楚的视觉中心；避免改变发型、衣着或手中物品。简化背景细节，但保留能辨认场所的主要结构。

[角色画法]
面部轮廓柔和、五官简练，眼睛有神但大小自然，眉毛精致、鼻子小巧简化、嘴巴轮廓清楚，脸颊轻微红润。适度风格化，保留人物原有气质，不夸张成大眼 Q 版。头发用流动细墨线、彩铅和干粉彩笔触表现，保留原有长度、颜色、分缝、蓬松度、生长方向与动态。

[材质与颜色]
以哑光水粉色块为基础，结合油画棒、蜡笔、彩色铅笔和干墨；局部带轻微做旧的丝网印刷质感。衣服和环境保留原有轮廓、颜色与图案，以松散线条和色块构建，呈现不均匀上色、干刷空隙、零散颗粒、可见纸纹及轻微手工不规则感。沿用原照的主色、光线、季节、天气和情绪，以温暖柔和的明暗塑造生活感，不强加其他季节或色调。

[约束]
只输出一张完整插画。避免光滑塑料 3D、摄影滤镜、无关装饰、额外人物、文字与水印。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Transform the uploaded photograph into one 3:2 landscape modern picture-book lifestyle illustration. Draw the entire image consistently; do not embed the original photograph or use a top/bottom comparison.

[People and setting]
Use the photograph as the source for identity, pose, expression, gaze, hair, clothing, accessories, important objects and environmental relationships. Preserve the camera angle, relative subject position and scale, body direction, visible body extent and key actions. Keep the person as the clear visual focus. Do not change the hairstyle, outfit or held objects. Simplify background details while retaining the main structures that identify the place.

[Character treatment]
Use soft facial contours, simplified features, expressive but naturally sized eyes, refined eyebrows, a small simplified nose, a clear mouth contour, and slight cheek warmth. Apply moderate stylization while preserving personality; avoid oversized chibi eyes. Render hair with flowing fine ink, colored-pencil and dry-pastel marks, preserving its original length, color, parting, volume, growth direction and movement.

[Materials and colors]
Build on matte gouache color masses with oil pastel, crayon, colored pencil and dry ink, plus subtle aged screen-print texture in selected areas. Preserve the clothing and surroundings’ shapes, colors and patterns through loose lines and color masses, with uneven coverage, dry-brush gaps, scattered grain, visible paper texture and slight handmade irregularities. Retain the source palette, lighting, season, weather and mood, using warm, gentle modeling without imposing another season or color cast.

[Constraints]
Return one complete illustration. Avoid smooth plastic 3D, a photographic filter treatment, unrelated decoration, extra people, added text and watermarks.

feishu-case-050.name: 厚涂油画风
feishu-case-050.style: 印象派厚涂油画，保留原图场景和主体特征，配合纸面肌理与手写排版。
feishu-case-050.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-050.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片重绘为一张 3:2 横版印象派厚涂油画艺术卡。整幅为连续绘画，不保留原始照片区，不分成上下两幅。

[主体与画面]
保留原图中人物或其他主体的识别特征、姿态、服装、情绪和主要空间关系。用原图真实存在的环境组成完整场景；主体自然落地，前后层次清楚。不自动添加人物、动物、草地或水面。

[厚涂语言]
用画笔与小刮刀堆叠颜料，表现清晰笔触、起伏边缘和局部刮抹痕。细节适度概括，以冷暖色块和笔触方向塑造光线与情绪，让人物的神态与情绪表现优先于机械写实细节。纸底为干净的奶油白，保留轻微纸纤维和颗粒肌理，边缘有不规则干刷和轻微晕开，画面自然融入纸面，不加硬边框。

[文字排版]
左上主标题写“Little Daydream”，其下小号副标题写“Let the heart follow the light.”；左下编号写“No.2025-0601”；右下使用比副标题和编号更小的字，贴近纸边，分两行写“Spring is what happens while”“you’re busy making other plans.”。
所有文字均为轻盈、有呼吸感的手写或书法笔迹，包括编号与小注释；不使用电脑打印体。文字清楚可读，避开主体，不添加其他文案或署名。

[气氛与约束]

promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Repaint the uploaded photograph as one 3:2 landscape impressionist impasto art card. Use a continuous painting across the whole canvas, with no original-photo area and no top/bottom diptych.

[Subject and scene]
Preserve the recognizable features, pose, clothing, emotion and main spatial relationships of the source subjects. Build the scene from the surroundings actually present in the photo. Ground subjects naturally and maintain readable depth. Do not automatically add people, animals, grass or water.

[Impasto language]
Build paint with brushes and small palette knives, showing strokes, raised edges and local scraping. Simplify details and use warm/cool color masses and stroke directions to express light and mood, prioritizing the subject’s expression and emotional presence over mechanical photographic detail. Use a clean cream-white paper ground with subtle fibers and grain, plus irregular dry-brushed and softly diffused edges that blend into the paper, without a hard frame.

[Typography]
At upper left write “Little Daydream”, with the smaller subtitle “Let the heart follow the light.” beneath. At lower left write “No.2025-0601”. At lower right near the paper edge, in lettering smaller than the subtitle and identifier, write “Spring is what happens while” and “you’re busy making other plans.” on two lines.
Use light, airy handwriting or calligraphic marks for every text element, including the identifier and small note. Do not use computer-printed type. Keep lettering readable and clear of the subject. Add no other copy or signature.

[Mood and constraints]
Quiet, bright, warm and slightly dreamlike while retaining the source time-of-day and weather. Keep exposed paper airy and avoid heavy shadows. Avoid photographic rendering, smooth 3D, muddy filters, unrelated faces, additional split panels and watermarks.

preservedText: Let the heart follow the light.

feishu-case-052.name: 照片重构
feishu-case-052.style: 照片重构。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。

feishu-case-052.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
将上传照片改编为一张 3:4 竖版的极简超现实摄影作品。保留原照片的核心主体与纪实细节，重新构筑它周围的空间；整幅仍具有真实摄影质感。

[主体保留]
保留主体的数量、身份、轮廓、材质、姿态及关键部件。人物保留面容、衣着和动作；车辆保留车身造型、朝向与关键标识。只保留与主体叙事相关的地面线条或可辨识文字，不凭空替换文字内容。

[空间重构]
移除冗余建筑、人群、树木和杂乱设施，以巨大平面墙体、地面和干净的几何交界建立空旷舞台。主体置于画面下部中轴附近，尺度相对环境较小；地面透视线指向主体。仅以空间尺度反差形成一个超现实重点，不叠加其他奇观。

[配色与光影]
使用砖红色地面和左侧窄墙面，与大面积蓝绿色背景形成对比。两者形成浓郁但不过饱和的大色场，以清楚的几何边界建立空间，而非仅对原背景局部换色。空间配色限定为砖红、蓝绿和少量中性明暗色，主体本身颜色保持真实。墙面与地面的透视、光线方向、接触阴影一致，表面细腻哑光，保留细微胶片颗粒、柔和高光过渡和克制锐度；皮肤与织物质感自然，避免 HDR 式局部强对比和过度锐化。

[约束]
不添加与主体无关的道具。避免主体变形、复制、悬浮，避免平面插画、塑料 3D、额外海报标题和水印。

promptLocales.en:
[Task and canvas]
Restage the uploaded photograph as one 3:4 portrait minimalist surreal photographic image. Retain the main subject and documentary details while rebuilding the surrounding space. The finished image should still look photographic.

[Subject preservation]
Keep subject count, identity, silhouette, material, pose and key parts. Preserve faces, clothing and gestures for people, or body design, direction and key markings for vehicles. Retain only ground lines or legible text relevant to the subject's story; do not invent replacement wording.

[Spatial reconstruction]
Remove redundant buildings, crowds, trees and street clutter. Construct an open stage from monumental flat walls, a ground plane and clean geometric junctions. Position the subject near the lower central axis, small relative to its surroundings. Ground perspective lines converge toward it. Use the scale contrast as the single surreal intervention rather than adding further spectacles.

[Color and lighting]
Contrast a brick-red ground and narrow left wall with a large teal backdrop. Use rich but not oversaturated color fields whose clear geometric boundaries construct the space, rather than merely recoloring isolated parts of the original background. Limit the spatial palette to brick red, teal and sparse neutral light/dark accents, while retaining the subject’s realistic colors. Keep wall and ground perspective, light direction and contact shadows consistent. Use fine matte surfaces, subtle film grain, soft highlight roll-off and restrained sharpness. Keep skin and fabrics natural; avoid HDR-like local contrast and oversharpening.

[Constraints]
Add no props unrelated to the subject. Avoid distorted, duplicated or floating subjects, flat illustration, plastic 3D, extra poster headlines and watermarks.

feishu-case-053.name: 专属图章
feishu-case-053.style: 专属图章。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-053.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-053.originalPrompt:
请将我上传的照片制作成一张「照片 × 定制图章」的档案风格拼接作品。

【整体构图】
画面由照片区与纸张区组成，比例约为 1:1。横版采用左右拼接，竖版采用上下拼接。两个矩形区域沿一条笔直的边界无缝相接，不要渐变、羽化、重叠、翻页、书脊或装饰分隔线。输出一张平面的完整作品。

【照片区】
忠实保留原照片的主体、数量、外形、位置关系、视角、光线、颜色和重要文字，只做适配版面所必需的裁切。不得增删物体或改造场景。如有人物，保留其身份特征、表情、姿势、服装和身体比例。

【纸张区】
使用干净的暖白色档案纸，带细微纤维、轻微米白与浅灰色变化，以及淡淡的扫描质感。不要严重泛黄、污渍、裂纹或烧焦效果。纸张区域约 70% 留白，图章与文字组合约占 30%，放在视觉平衡的角落，不要居中。

【定制图章】
根据照片主体设计一枚专属图章，将主体提炼成有辨识度的印刷图形，保留关键轮廓、结构及原照片的代表性色彩。
根据主体选择圆形、方框形、横向长幅、拱形或主体剪影形。若采用方框，必须有四边完整、清晰可辨的正方形墨线边框，内部图案保持可见。
使用粗糙丝网印刷、干墨、磨损网点、轻微缺墨、不均匀压力和少量套色偏移表现手工盖印质感。选取一种主体代表色作为主要墨色，少量辅助色保持低饱和。图章应像直接印在纸上，避免缩小照片、贴纸、光滑矢量图或实心色块的效果。

【文字】
在图章旁添加小号、略微褪色的打字机字体，不要覆盖图章。
标题：[填写简短标题；未填写则根据照片生成简短英文标题]
副标题：[填写 3—5 个关键词，以 / 分隔；未填写则根据照片提炼]
文字拼写准确，保持简洁，不添加无关标签或大段说明。

【最终效果】
安静、克制、有触感，具有私人收藏与影像档案的记忆感。确保照片区忠实、拼接线笔直、图章位置合理、留白充足。不要水印、现代字体、剪贴簿装饰、立体展示样机或虚构内容。

recipe.effect: 参考专属图章样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。

promptLocales.en:
Please turn my uploaded photograph into an archival-style “Photograph × Custom Stamp” composition.

[Overall Composition]
Divide the image into a photograph panel and a paper panel in approximately equal proportions (1:1). For landscape formats, place them side by side; for portrait formats, stack them vertically. Join the two rectangular panels seamlessly along a single straight boundary, with no gradients, feathering, overlap, page curls, book spines or decorative dividers. Output one complete, flat composition.

[Photograph Panel]
Faithfully preserve the original photograph's subjects, count, shapes, spatial relationships, camera angle, lighting, colors and important text. Crop only as necessary to fit the layout. Do not add or remove objects or alter the scene. If people are present, preserve their identifying features, expressions, poses, clothing and body proportions.

[Paper Panel]
Use clean, warm-white archival paper with subtle fibers, slight off-white and light-gray variations, and a faint scanned texture. Avoid heavy yellowing, stains, cracks or scorched effects. Leave approximately 70% of the paper panel blank. The stamp and text together should occupy approximately 30%, positioned in a visually balanced corner rather than in the center.

[Custom Stamp]
Design a bespoke stamp based on the photograph's subjects, distilling them into a recognizable printed graphic while preserving key contours, structures and characteristic colors from the original photograph.
Choose a circle, square frame, wide horizontal format, arch or subject-silhouette shape to suit the subjects. If using a square frame, include a clearly recognizable square ink-line border with all four sides complete, keeping the graphic inside visible.
Convey a hand-stamped texture through rough screen printing, dry ink, worn halftone dots, small areas of missing ink, uneven pressure and slight color-registration offsets. Choose one characteristic subject color as the primary ink, with small amounts of low-saturation supporting colors. The stamp should look printed directly onto the paper; avoid the appearance of a miniature photograph, sticker, smooth vector graphic or solid block of color.

[Text]
Place small, slightly faded typewriter lettering beside the stamp without covering it.
Title: [Enter a short title; if left blank, generate a short English title based on the photograph]
Subtitle: [Enter 3–5 keywords separated by /; if left blank, derive them from the photograph]
Keep spelling accurate and wording concise. Do not add unrelated labels or lengthy explanations.

[Final Effect]
Quiet, restrained and tactile, evoking the memories held in a private collection and photographic archive. Ensure a faithful photograph panel, a straight joining seam, a well-positioned stamp and ample negative space. No watermarks, modern typefaces, scrapbook decorations, three-dimensional display mockups or invented content.

# [DESIGN TASK] Independent Editorial Art Poster Generator

## 1. Core Layout & Structure (画面结构)
- **Canvas Ratio**: 3:4 vertical composition.
- **Layout Rule**: Strictly split into two regions of equal height (50% upper, 50% lower). No multi-image stitching, single output per photo.
- **Upper Half (Original Photo Zone)**:
  - Keep original subject identity, structure, pose, real texture, and natural lighting.
  - Apply a light, high-end editorial color grade (art magazine/exhibition style).
  - *Modification Rule*: You may naturally extend the environment to fit the frame, but never stretch, distort, or alter the subject.
- **Lower Half (Reinterpretation Zone)**:
  - Do not repaint the photo. Distill its core meaning, emotion, or metaphor, and rebuild it as a hand-drawn, collage-style mixed-media illustration.
  - *Symbolism / Metaphor (Customizable)*: [填写你想赋予下半部分的意图/心理隐喻，例如：A quiet, reflective journey, symbolizing solitude and a slower tomorrow / 留白、孤独与缓慢的明天]

## 2. Visual Storytelling & Object Language (叙事媒介与办公物件语言)
- **Primary Language**: Reorganized common office & daily items functioning as narrative elements (not simple decoration).
- **Included Elements (Selectable)**: [可按需勾选或替换]
  - Sticky notes / memos with handwritten text
  - Folders, paperclips, binder clips, staples
  - Washi tape, transparent tape, translucent film
  - Rulers, stamps, postal marks, boarding passes, receipts, envelopes
  - Torn paper corners, form fragments
- **Handmade Integration**: Mix in partial line work, paper scraps, and handwritten marks so the page reads like a considered visual diary or editorial collage.

## 3. Composition & Whitespace (构图与留白艺术)
- **Whitespace Strategy**: Large areas of deliberate, active whitespace acting as a core design element (not empty background).
- **Composition Dynamics**: Create depth through positive/negative shapes, density, grouping, rhythm, and asymmetric balance. Elements can sit off-center, hug edges, hang suspended, or be partly cropped.
- **Aesthetic Principle**: "Cut rather than fill"—keep it light, restrained, and breathing.

## 4. Mixed Media & Texture (混合媒介与材质肌理)
- **Techniques**: Paper collage, hand drawing, watercolor, colored pencil, fine line work, and minimal handwritten notes.
- **Tactile Quality**: Slight cut edges, paper grain, hand-drawn outlines, and irregular textures for real handmade warmth (avoid clean digital filters or templates).

## 5. Color Palette (色彩方案)
- **Source Extraction**: Take the most memorable and emotionally charged colors from the uploaded photo.
- **Palette Treatment**: Reorganize into a light, coordinated palette with a lived-in feel. Brighten, purify, and remove grayness.
- **Base & Accents**: Light paper base with a few restrained theme colors. Avoid muddy grays, heavy retro, cheap high saturation, or cluttered colors.
- *Current Vibe (Customizable)*: [可自定义色彩基调，例如：Soft lavender, sunset pink, icy glacier blue, and muted cream / 柔和的薰衣草紫、日落粉、冰川蓝与乳白纸张底色]

## 6. Minimal Editorial Typography (极简文字点缀)
- **Constraint**: Minimal editorial touch only. No preset titles, numbering, or heavy text blocks.
- **Content Source**: Draw a few words, short phrases, or notes from the location, emotion, or metaphor of the source.
- *Embedded Text (Customizable)*: [可替换你想融入的短句，例如：
  - Upper: "SOME PRODUCTS STILL BELIEVE IN A SLOWER TOMORROW"
  - Lower: "A quieter world is also a kind of progress."
]

## 7. Negative Constraints (负向约束 - 避免以下雷区)
- Avoid object-by-object copying, filled canvases, asset listing, and over-decoration.
- Avoid commercial journal template feel, cartoon feel, 3D render feel, and cheap DIY collage.

promptLocales.zh-CN:
# [设计任务] 独立编辑艺术海报生成器

## 1. 核心布局与结构
- **画幅比例**：3:4 竖版构图。
- **布局规则**：严格分为两个等高区域（上方 50%，下方 50%）。不拼接多张图片，每张照片独立输出。
- **上半部分（原始照片区）**：
  - 保留原始主体身份、结构、姿态、真实纹理和自然光照。
  - 施加轻微的高端编辑调色（艺术杂志/展览风格）。
  - *修改规则*：可自然延伸环境以适配画幅，但绝不拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。
- **下半部分（再诠释区）**：
  - 不直接重绘照片。提炼核心含义、情绪或隐喻，重构为手绘、拼贴式混合媒材插画。
  - *象征/隐喻（可自定义）*：[填写希望赋予下半部分的意图/心理隐喻，例如：一次安静、内省的旅程，象征孤独与更缓慢的明天 / 留白、孤独与缓慢的明天]

## 2. 视觉叙事与办公物件语言
- **主要语言**：将日常办公与生活物品重新组织为叙事元素，而非简单装饰。
- **可选元素**：[可按需勾选或替换]
  - 带手写文字的便签/备忘纸
  - 文件夹、回形针、长尾夹、订书钉
  - 和纸胶带、透明胶带、半透明薄膜
  - 尺子、印章、邮戳、登机牌、收据、信封
  - 撕纸角、表格碎片
- **手工融合**：混入局部线稿、纸屑和手写痕迹，让画面呈现经过构思的视觉日记或编辑拼贴。

## 3. 构图与留白
- **留白策略**：大面积有意安排、发挥作用的留白是核心设计元素，而非空背景。
- **构图动态**：通过正负形、疏密、分组、节奏与不对称平衡建立纵深。元素可偏心、贴边、悬挂或局部裁切。
- **美学原则**：“做减法而非填满”——保持轻盈、克制、富有呼吸感。

## 4. 混合媒材与纹理
- **技法**：纸张拼贴、手绘、水彩、彩色铅笔、细线稿和极少量手写注释。
- **触感**：细微切边、纸张颗粒、手绘轮廓与不规则纹理，呈现真实手工温度（避免干净的数字滤镜或模板感）。

## 5. 配色
- **来源提取**：从上传照片中取出最令人记忆深刻、最具情绪感染力的色彩。
- **处理方式**：重组为轻盈、协调且有生活气息的配色。提亮、提纯、去灰。
- **底色与点缀**：浅色纸底搭配少量克制的主题色。避免浑浊灰、厚重复古、廉价高饱和或杂乱配色。
- *当前色调（可自定义）*：[可自定义色彩基调，例如：柔和薰衣草紫、日落粉、冰冷冰川蓝与低饱和奶油色 / 柔和的薰衣草紫、日落粉、冰川蓝与乳白纸张底色]

## 6. 极简编辑文字
- **约束**：只作极少量编辑点缀。不预设标题、编号或厚重文字块。
- **内容来源**：从原图的地点、情绪或隐喻中提取几个单词、短句或注释。
- *嵌入文案（可自定义）*：[可替换希望融入的短句，例如：
  - 上方："SOME PRODUCTS STILL BELIEVE IN A SLOWER TOMORROW"
  - 下方："A quieter world is also a kind of progress."
]

## 7. 负面约束
- 避免逐物复制、填满画布、罗列素材和过度装饰。
- 避免商业手帐模板感、卡通感、3D 渲染感和廉价手工拼贴感。

feishu-case-060.originalPrompt:
[任务优先级与整体布局]
使用上传的第 1 张原始照片，制作一张 3:4 竖版上下对比海报。它由两个独立区域组成：上半区保留原始摄影画面，下半区才做纸雕艺术重构。保留上半区原照的优先级高于整张海报的风格统一；不要把整张图一起转成纸艺。
画面在高度 50% 处水平分界，上下各占一半；每个区域均为 3:2 横版。两区只在主体身份、数量、姿态和空间关系上呼应，材质和光照分别处理，不做风格渐变或跨区融合。

[上半区：保留上传原照，禁止风格化]
- 内容：直接使用第 1 张上传照片的摄影画面。保留原主体身份、数量、姿态、相对位置、透视、背景、真实色彩、原始光照与镜头景深；清晰部分保留细密自然纹理，虚焦背景保留原来的光学虚化。
- 适配：只允许等比缩放，以及适配本区域 3:2 横版所必需的最少裁切，优先保留完整主体和关键细节。不得拉伸、变形、重新构图或替换背景。
- 区域限制：上半区不重绘、不简化为色块、不插画化，不添加纸纤维、剪纸边缘、折痕、纸层、纸雕投影、奶白纸底、文字或装饰。下半区的材料、配色处理和照明指令均不适用于上半区。

[下半区：仅在此区域进行纸雕艺术重构]
- 内容：用同一张原照中的主体制作纸雕版本，保留主体身份、数量、动作和主要空间关系，使它能与上半区一一对应。
- 材质与光影：奶白色细纤维哑光纸底（Matte paper with subtle fibers）；纸张切边利落、厚度轻薄；左上方单侧柔光照射，产生方向一致的自然窄投影（Narrow shadows）；杜绝塑料高光、黏土感或厚纸板堆叠感。这些纸质和灯光效果只存在于下半区。
- 空间与立体：提炼原图主体的外轮廓、主色调与视觉重心；将远景、中景、近景解构为清晰可辨的独立纸层（Layered paper relief）；严格通过剪切（Cutting）、压折（Creasing）、卷曲（Curling）表现物理结构，严禁靠虚假渐变充当立体感。

promptLocales.en:
[Task Priority & Overall Layout]
Use the first uploaded original photograph to create a 3:4 portrait comparison poster. It consists of two independent regions: preserve the original photographic image in the upper half, and apply paper-sculpture reconstruction only in the lower half. Preserving the upper photograph takes priority over stylistic consistency across the poster; do not turn the entire image into paper art.
Divide the canvas horizontally at 50% of its height, with equal upper and lower halves; each panel is 3:2 landscape. Echo subject identity, count, poses and spatial relationships across the panels, but handle their materials and lighting independently. No gradual style transition or cross-panel blending.

[Upper Half: Preserve the Uploaded Photograph, No Stylization]
- Content: Directly use the photographic image from the first upload. Preserve subject identity, count, poses, relative positions, perspective, background, true colors, original lighting and lens depth of field. Retain fine natural textures in sharp areas and the original optical blur in out-of-focus backgrounds.
- Fit: Only proportion-preserving resizing and the minimum cropping needed to fit this 3:2 landscape panel are allowed. Prioritize complete subjects and key details. No stretching, deformation, recomposition or background replacement.
- Region restrictions: Do not redraw the upper half, simplify it into color blocks or illustrate it. Add no paper fibers, cut-paper edges, creases, paper layers, paper-relief shadows, cream paper ground, text or decoration. Material, palette-treatment and lighting instructions for the lower half do not apply to the upper half.

[Lower Half: Paper Sculpture Reconstruction Only Here]
- Content: Make a paper-sculpture version of the subjects in the same original photograph. Preserve subject identity, count, actions and main spatial relationships so they correspond to the upper photograph.
- Materials & light: Cream-white matte paper base with fine fibers; crisp, thin paper cut edges; soft light from the upper left only, creating consistent natural narrow shadows. No plastic highlights, clay texture or thick stacked-cardboard look. These paper and lighting effects exist only in the lower half.
- Space & volume: Distill the original subjects' outer contours, main colors and visual center of gravity. Deconstruct far, middle and near planes into distinct independent layers of paper relief. Convey physical structure strictly through cutting, creasing and curling; never use false gradients to imitate volume.
- Palette & selection: Extract colors from the original. Simplify cluttered backgrounds only in the lower half, emphasizing the subjects with clear hierarchy and breathing room. Paper layers, shadows and decorations must not cross the midpoint into the upper half.

[Typography & Copy: Entirely Within the Lower Half]
- Main title: In suitable negative space within the lower half, add a short title, "[Replace text here, e.g., STILL WINGS]", using sophisticated, clear serif type. Match the subject's palette and stagger the title in visual dialogue with it, without obscuring key details.
- Credit: At the bottom center or along a side of the lower half, add a miniature typographic credit: "[Replace credit here, e.g., CAUSETXN / PAPER STUDIES]".

[Output Check]
Return one stacked comparison poster: the upper half must still look like the original camera photograph, while the lower half must clearly be paper sculpture. Paper, illustration or miniature-model textures in both halves fail the requirement. No unrelated decoration, garbled text, misspellings or existing commercial brand logos.

feishu-case-062.name: 厚涂油画 · 微缩景观
feishu-case-062.style: 厚涂油画 · 微缩景观。以效果图和模板为参考，按本次需求调整主体、内容与视觉表达。
feishu-case-062.suggestion: 用这个风格处理我上传的照片
feishu-case-062.originalPrompt:
[任务与画幅]
从上传照片中提取主要主体、轮廓、姿态和场景关系，重绘为一张 1:1 方形厚涂油画微景观插画。只输出风格化成品，不嵌入原照，不做上下双联。

[构图与场景提炼]
主体位于中心附近，保持身份与关键特征，可适度概括细节。以一条沿斜向主轴展开、局部自然弯曲的清透厚涂彩色景观带承托主体，形态取自照片中的海岸、水面、道路或地形，和主体形成真实接触及连续空间关系。水面保留简化的倒影与波纹，地面或路径以光斑和延展笔触表现方向；这些痕迹与对应表面一致。外围大量留出白色纹理纸面，少量远景或云层自然融入纸白。

[颜料与体积]
用厚油彩、刮刀堆叠和短笔触塑造微缩实体般的体积。高光、水面、云层及景观带边缘有明显颜料起伏和刮痕，主体细节相对克制。将厚涂油画的物质感、微缩实体的体积和清透光感结合；色带局部呈薄透、透光般的笔触，与不透明厚颜料交替。所有立体感来自颜料和半手工塑形，不做光滑树脂手办，不增加独立展示底座。

[配色与光感]
从原图挑选最明亮、鲜活的主色重新调制，不平均取色；提高明度与色彩纯净度，以大量暖白平衡清透的天空蓝与湖水青；点睛色从原图自然推导的嫩绿、暖橙、金黄、桃粉中选取少量，表现阳光般的高光，不要求全部颜色出现。色彩鲜明而不刺眼，冷暖关系清爽。保持光线方向一致，将原场景色彩提炼为明亮、鲜活、温暖的气氛，不新增原图没有的故事元素。

[约束]
主体与色带清楚、背景轻盈；不新增文字或水印，避免灰脏暗褐滤镜、低沉莫兰迪色、霓虹色、廉价糖果色、摄影拼贴和生硬分区。

recipe.effect: 参考厚涂油画 · 微缩景观样例及当前Prompt理解画面关系，由用户需求决定如何迁移。
